Should have spend the extra money a LONG time ago. I was buying the Revlon $20 blow dryers from local Kroger each year. Xtava Saves me time daily by drying my hair faster. The diffuser is great and makes my curls hold together, but yet still fluffy appearance. The cord is very strong and longer than I need, But I think it will last long. The dryer does have switches where I place my hand (righty), but I am getting used to it- only negative.  Love love love! Buy it!

Really nice hair dryer!!  My one issue is that the buttons are in kind of an awkward spot and it's easy to hit them with my palm/thumb on accident...so I wind up having to hold it at the bottom near the cord when I dry my hair and it can get heavy on the wrist.  Other than that it does a really nice job and my hair dries FAST!  My mop has never been so shiny...must be all them ions. ;)

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the dryer for drying hair quickly and saving time, especially with the diffuser for curly hair.
Several reviewers complain that the buttons/switches are awkwardly placed and easy to hit accidentally, turning the dryer off or changing settings.
A number of reviewers report the dryer breaking or malfunctioning, including stopping heat, only blowing cold air, or sparking/fire hazards.
Reviewers frequently describe the dryer as quiet and well-built, with good materials and a long cord.
Some reviewers with thick or curly hair say it takes longer to dry than expected or did not reduce drying time.
